questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that other vehicles may be merging into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. The hill may be long, steep, or have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs with a yellow-green background alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign warns of sharp turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction the arrow points. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This sign shows how much vertical space is available under a bridge or overpass. In this example, there is 12 feet 6 inches of clearance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like tractors and farm equipment display an orange and red triangle on the back to warn other drivers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves and bends.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A downward-pointing triangle is always a yield sign. Be ready to slow down or stop when you see it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of curves ahead or a narrow road. You may see these signs before sharp curves or narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs warn drivers and pedestrians about construction, maintenance, survey, and utility work areas. They help people stay safe in these dangerous zones. Traffic fines can double in areas marked by these signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on any road. When you see a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. You can only proceed when it is safe and clear for you to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide service information. They tell drivers about nearby rest areas, food, gas stations, hospitals, and other motorist services.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway begins ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to conditions immediately ahead. This sign warns about a curve coming up to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downgrade ahead. Check your brakes before going down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic will soon combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate work zones ahead. Stay alert for unexpected driving conditions. This sign warns you that a flagger is coming. You must follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You may see this sign at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows a crosswalk ahead. When you see it, be ready and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They tell drivers about upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that a stop sign is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows a divided highway is starting. Keep to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular yellow sign with black lettering shows a no passing zone. It appears on the left side of two-lane roads where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must bear either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road splits. You must choose to go right or left.
